name: PR Overview shows the seeded brief (survives a reload) and a review-focus item deep-links into Files changed
description: Opens PR #482 and checks the seeded pr_brief cache row (server/src/db/seed.ts): the brief summary on the Overview tab, then a full page reload to prove it is read from the cache, not regenerated. Then clicks the in-hunk review-focus item for src/middleware/ratelimit.ts line 9 and checks the deep link (?tab=diff&file=<encoded>&line=9), the file card and the highlighted row (CodeLine marks the target aria-current=location). Read-only seeded data: never clicks Generate / Refresh brief (that calls the LLM, see e2e/INSIGHTS.md). Waits for the PR row text before clicking (list fetch race). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (run via ./scripts/e2e.sh).
